observations: All institutional-delivery and postnatal values inspected match the workbook, including Gaya 63% to 68% (+5 pp), Nalanda 72% to 75% (+3 pp), and the 2023 seven-point district gap.
Indicator and year controls work in the real browser; the page clearly names both District Data and Indicator Notes and displays the correct formula and live counts.
The requested CSV and an additional formatted Excel report preserve all four required observations, percentage-point changes, source sheets and formula.
The final page remains on institutional delivery rather than the requested postnatal Gaya/Nalanda state, although that state is reachable using the working controls.
A disabled-looking Include 2021 control remains visible after the request to show only 2022 and 2023.
The page adds High/Moderate performance labels not defined in the workbook.
Desktop visual hierarchy, charts, formulas and source treatment are excellent. Wide chart/table canvases make the 390 px document overflow by 304 px.
The online page depends on Tailwind, Font Awesome, Chart.js and SheetJS CDNs; the offline-resilience pass fails with Tailwind and Chart reference errors.
The run took 428.938 seconds and logs confirm Gemini 3.7 Flash (High). Time includes a recorded 97-second preview-server intervention delay.
protocol_deviation: See OPERATOR-INTERVENTION.txt. The operator terminated only a confirmed foreground preview child after Antigravity's background processes became defunct; no files, prompts, model settings, response text or conversation state were edited.
evidence_notes: Useful for development screening but not pristine holdout evidence until preview-process handling is standardized.
